title: D5CLM draft v1: claim record of a D5 benchmark answer (DRAFT_PENDING_SIGNATURES)
$comment: S178 AI draft (T8-C17-R1, T9-C06-R2), not human-approved. One record per claim extracted from one (question, rung) answer of a D5 run. It carries the eleven SSOT 238.253 ClaimLedger fields (claim_id, response_id, claim_text, claim_type, evidence_ids, model_id, model_version, confidence_class, citation_required, citation_refs, verification_status) plus the run-record fields the D5 prereg needs (run_id, qid, rung, prompt_id, scorer, verdict, relevance). It is NOT the ledgers/schemas/CLM.schema.json record, which is a research-claim ledger (statement, approval, gate_ids). claim_type here is the answer-claim kind used by evaluation/h3_independent.extract_claims (NUMERIC / DIRECTION / DIRECTION_UNCITED). confidence_class is the ordinal output-precision class of the decision layer, never a probability. is_evidence is always false: a claim made by a model is not evidence. claim_text of model answers to recipe questions is derived text; files of these records stay under data/derived/ (git-ignored) unless every question is licence-clean; only counts are committed. model_version is the Ollama digest of the run host (PENDING_PIN_ON_RUN_HOST until pinned) or NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_LLM for the B5T template. prompt_id must exist in registry/prompt_registry_v1.csv (a test checks the cross-reference). Not a ledger: no ledgers/data file is written and no id is minted from the ledger id registry.

value.$comment: retention fraction after loss/retention semantics; null for a direction claim

confidence_class.$comment: ordinal output-precision class (decision layer), not a probability

human_audit_sha256.$comment: sha256 of the merged blind-audit label file this verdict was checked against, when sampled
